style: Avant-garde vocal-group polyphony and theater-band orchestration. Harmony: quartal suspended fields with microtonal pure interval friction against equal-tempered beds. Melody: angular phrasing, yodel register flips, and rests carrying melodic contour. Rhythm: polymetric 5:4 against polyrhythmic 3:2 under contact-pulse stomping and exertion decay. Timbre: talking drum, santoor, ney, clavioline, stylophone, subtractive synthesis, daxophone, and gamelan metallophones. Performance attitude: camp theatrical overstatement combined with sensory overload and afterglow cosmic domesticity. Anchor: fixed pitch-class number mapping. Operators: compress vowel duration while expanding consonant timing; hold subharmonic root fixed while upper structures drift; make the rhythmic percussion govern vocal pitch; force extreme-latency radio delay to clash with live ensemble downbeats. Maximum kinetic velocity and hyper-drive structural overload.
lyrics:
[SECTION 1 - OPENING MIGRATION] [ADDRESSEE: UNBORN LISTENER] [ENSEMBLE: SIMULTANEOUS TRANSLATION CHOIR] [TIMBRE: TALKING DRUM AND SANTOOR] [PHYSICAL GESTURE: CONTACT PULSE] [LANGUAGE TRANSFER: UBYKH PHONOLOGY] 

(Choir Voice 1)
We packed the meat in salt and morning light, preserving every single fibre against the creeping damp of the damp cellar.
(Choir Voice 2)
Linguistic pressure hits the alveolar ridge with absolute grammatical finality, forcing the glottis to shudder!
(Choir Voice 3)
Before you even exist as a statistical probability, we are already thoroughly wet with stuff, waiting for the morning bell.

[RHYTHMIC SHIFT: POLYRHYTHM 3:2 ACTIVATED - SYNCHRONIZING THE METRONOMIC PULSE WITH THE TICKING OF THE KITCHEN CLOCK] 

[SECTION 2 - THE FIRST FACT AND THE DECAY] [CONSTRAINT: ONE NEW FACT PER SECTION] [TIMBRE: NEY AND CLAVIOLINE] [GESTURE: EXERTION DECAY] 

(Choir Voice 1)
Fact one: the greasy substance adheres to the linoleum floor without your explicit permission or prior notification.
(Choir Voice 2)
(Ubykh transferred vowels with microtonal bending)
Ae-ih-ou, the cold meat has terrible weight today, dragging down the entire foundation of the suburban home!
(Choir Voice 3)
The clavioline stabs the breakfast toast repeatedly, mimicking the sharp anxiety of a missed mortgage payment.

[TRANSMISSION DELAY: 14 YEARS LATENCY - BUFFER OVERFLOW IN THE MENTAL ARCHIVE] 

[SECTION 3 - NUMBER TO PITCH CLASS] [TRANSDUCTION ACTIVE] [TIMBRE: STYLOPHONE AND DAXOPHONE] 

(Choir Voice 1)
Digit seven maps directly to G-sharp below the sensory threshold, vibrating inside the hollow spaces of the skull.
(Choir Voice 2)
The daxophone groans like an old floorboard bearing the unexpected weight of an unwanted historical epoch.
(Choir Voice 3)
We wash the dirty dishes meticulously after the absolute cosmic collapse, ensuring no grease remains upon the ceramic.

[FAILURE MODE: CHECKPOINT RESTART TRIGGERED BY SYSTEM ERROR 404 - MEMORY CORRUPTION IN THE BREAKFAST NOOK] 

[SECTION 4 - RECONSTRUCTION FROM SCAR] [TIMBRE: GAMELAN METALLOPHONE FAMILY] [SUBHARMONIC TUNING FIELD] 

(Choir Voice 1)
Restart cleanly from the deeply scarred memory of cooking oil and burnt toast crumbs scattered across the counter.
(Choir Voice 2)
Subharmonic undertones drag the rotting floorboards down into the abyss of domestic repetition and endless chores.
(Choir Voice 3)
No backtracking is ever allowed across the broken seam of linear time; we must press forward into the batter.

[RHYTHMIC SHIFT: POLYMETER 5:4 AGAINST 4:3 - CONTESTING THE RHYTHM OF THE HOUSEHOLD CHORE ENGINE] 

[SECTION 5 - THE EXPLANATION ARRIVES] [CONSTRAINT: EVERY EVENT EXPLAINED LATER] [TIMBRE: SUBTRACTIVE SYNTHESIS AND TALKING DRUM] 

(Choir Voice 1)
That terrifying noise earlier was merely the heavy meat sliding unceremoniously off the laminate counter.
(Choir Voice 2)
Listen closely as the talking drum flawlessly mimics the urgent speech of a sizzling frying pan at dawn.
(Choir Voice 3)
We meticulously explain the laws of gravity long after the floorboards have already buckled under the sheer mass.

[AUDIENCE SCORE UNLOCKS FORM TRANSITION - LEVEL TWO DOMESTIC PURGATORY INITIALIZED] 

[SECTION 6 - THE FINAL DOMESTIC HORROR] [CAMP THEATRICAL EXAGGERATION] [FULL ENSEMBLE OVERLOAD] 

(Choir Voice 1)
Toast the stale bread! Feed the hungry meat! Slam your consciousness right back into the sticky stuff of life!
(Choir Voice 2)
The mourning ney breathes freezing winter frost over the pathetic butter knife, icing over the dairy products!
(Choir Voice 3)
We are horribly conscious and it is disgustingly tangible, echoing through every corridor of the burning house!

[END OF TRANSMISSION - DELAY ARTIFACT ECHO FADING INTO PERPETUAL STATIC]
caption: An avant-garde theatrical polyphony driven by Ubykh-transferred vocal choirs, extreme-latency radio delay, and a hyper-dense sonic palette featuring talking drums, santoors, daxophones, and gamelan metallophones. Operating under extreme sensory overload and afterglow cosmic domesticity, the piece deploys subharmonic tunings, polymetric structures, and deterministic pitch mapping to narrate the existential horror of waking up trapped inside physical meat.
